Shell script that configures and starts firedancer-dev under gdb for a local test ledger.

# Purpose
This Bash script prepares and starts a `firedancer-dev` local test run for a Solana ledger replay and validator setup. It finds the primary network interface and IP address, waits for the local Solana node to reach a target block height, downloads the latest snapshot, and reads the shred version from `validator.log`. It then writes a `firedancer-dev.toml` configuration file with gossip, replay, consensus, path, funk, log, and RPC settings, runs several `firedancer-dev configure init` steps, and finally launches `firedancer-dev` under `gdb` for debugging. The script also removes old local state files and kills any existing `firedancer-dev` process during cleanup.
